fixed_on: 2026-09-30, before the first protocol run; the criteria mirror static_drop_2d/tolerances.json

protocol.time_step: dt <= m * dt_B, dt_B = sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) = (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma)), rounded down so that the run is 100 equal output intervals; m = 2 at La = 12 and m = 1 at La = 120, taken from the 2D step-0 measurement (tracker M2, jobs 46075447 and 46076505). The 3D values of m are assumed from 2D and must be checked once in 3D (README.md). The gated metrics are relaxed steady-state values, so the time step does not enter them (decision D10).
protocol.transport: Level-set advection velocity (decision D9): pde_extension once the solver has it, wet_extension until then, coupled for comparison. Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, transport, Laplace number) refinement study.
protocol.note: R/h = 32 (5.3 million tetrahedra, about 4,000 steps at La = 12) may not be affordable with the current per-step cost; without it the pressure-jump criterion cannot be evaluated (README.md, Expected cost per level).

criteria.definition: |(p_in - p_ext) - 2*gamma/R_eff| / (2*gamma/R_eff) at the end of the run. p_in is the volume-weighted mean of the P1 pressure over the tetrahedra lying entirely inside the ball of radius R_eff/2 about the liquid centroid; R_eff = (3V/(4*pi))^(1/3), V the exact volume of {phi_h < 0}.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(R/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: pressure-jump error <= 1% at R/h = 32 with observed order >= 1), as for static_drop_2d

criteria.definition: Ca_sp = mu * max|u_h| / gamma, max over the vertices with phi_h < 0, taking the largest value over the outputs in the final quarter of the run (t > 3T/4).
criteria.source: Decision of 2026-09-29 recorded in the tracker (section 5, M2), as for static_drop_2d: no absolute limit; the spurious flow must decrease strictly under refinement, and no_velocity_growth must hold. Absolute values are reported.

criteria.definition: max|u_h| (liquid vertices) at the end of the run divided by the largest max|u_h| over the outputs in the third quarter of the run (T/2 <= t <= 3T/4). A ratio <= 1 means the final value lies within the envelope of the preceding quarter.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: no growth of max|u| in time)

criteria.definition: max over the run of |V(t) - V(0)| / V(0), with V the exact volume of {phi_h < 0} and V(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu. The maximum is taken over all outputs and, when the solver log is present and its per-step wet volume matches the snapshot volume at every output to 1e-8, over every step of the log.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: volume drift <= 1e-4), measured as the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11)
